653:t_003:12.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「But we're able to talk with those two, $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$...」

653:t_003:14.en:
$$弁慶$$
「If $$バアル$$ means enemies we can't communicate with, does that mean the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s don't fit the bill...!」

653:t_003:15.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「What are you saying! Since the age of myth, it has been decided that the ravenous destroyers are $$バアル$$!」

653:t_003:18.en:
$$隼人$$
「The $$インベーダー#pilot$$s seek evolution through the $$ゲッター線$$... And in that...」

653:t_004:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「Tch! They couldn't care less about our situation!」

653:t_004:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「So to them, we and $$ミケーネ$$ are all the same!」

653:t_004:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Whether those creatures are $$バアル$$ or not, there is no doubt they are our enemies!」

653:t_004:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I don't care what title they go by, $$バアル$$ or whatever! I'll smash every last one that comes at me!」

653:t_004:4.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Those who press on with their comrades, fearing nothing... At this rate, they...」

653:t_004:5.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「But that is exactly as it should be! They are worthy opponents for me, a hero!」

653:t_004:6.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Come, Earthlings! And you, ravenous destroyers! $$勇者ガラダブラ#pilot$$ will devour the lot of you!」

653:t_004:7.en:
$n
「Looks like you've steeled yourself, hero of $$ミケーネ$$!」

653:t_004:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then we'll crush you, resolve and all! So that we can survive in this universe!」

653:t_005:0.en:
$$凱$$
「All right! Both $$ミケーネ$$ and the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s are wiped out!」

653:t_005:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But to think the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s might not be $$バアル$$...」

653:t_005:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ノノ$$'s free-spirited way of thinking made us realize something unexpected.」

653:t_005:3.en:
$$ノノ$$

653:t_005:4.en:

653:t_005:5.en:

653:t_005:6.en:
$$チコ$$
「Just because there's no one here to call her out, she's getting carried away...」

653:t_005:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$隼人$$... Earlier you said something about evolution and whatnot, but...」

653:t_005:8.en:
$$隼人$$
「Most likely, it was the work of the $$御使い$$s that got the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s called $$バアル$$ as well.」

653:t_005:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Those guys... just how many pies have they got their fingers in...」

653:t_006:1.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「As expected, you have come through evolution. You could even say you now stand at the threshold of $$シンカ$$.」

653:t_006:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What is this $$シンカ$$ you speak of!?」

653:t_006:3.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「You have no need to know.」

653:t_006:4.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Exactly...! $$シンカ$$ belongs to us!」

653:t_007:1.en:
$$號$$
「The dimension is warping...! No... it's trying to tear apart!」

653:t_007:2.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「Exactly! From this moment, this universe is ruled by the void!」

653:t_007:3.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Earthlings! Offer your lives... and your souls, together with your steel bodies, to us!」

653:t_008:0.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Wh-whoaaaa! To think you've defeated $$ガラダブラ$$ twice!」

653:t_008:2.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「...I gave it everything I had. If I must fall to the likes of you, then I have no regrets...」

653:t_008:4.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Among the gods of $$オリュンポス$$, I was called a hero... Steel warriors who defeated me! You shall be the ones to bear the name of hero!」

653:t_008:5.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「And if I may wish for one thing... let the hammer fall upon them...! Upon the $$御使い$$s!!」

653:t_009:0.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Magnificent, $$ガラダブラ$$. That was a death worthy of the name of hero.」

653:t_009:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「You and we were enemies to the very end. But we won't forget your last wish...」

653:t_009:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's not for your sake... For ourselves and for everything we have to protect, we swear we'll defeat the $$御使い$$s without fail.」

653:t_100:0.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Let us settle this, $$マジンガーＺ$$! And you, $$兜甲児$$!」

653:t_100:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「Looks like you've learned my name and $$マジンガー$$'s!」

653:t_100:2.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「You are warrior enough for that! To remember the name of an opponent worth challenging with all one's strength is the courtesy of battle!」

653:t_100:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Thanks, $$ガラダブラ$$! You really are the man they praised as a hero!」

653:t_100:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「But we're the ones who win! As long as you go after Earth for your own goals, we'll fight $$ミケーネ$$!」

653:t_101:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I'm sick of looking at those three faces of yours, $$ガラダブラ$$!」

653:t_101:1.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Bold words, warrior of the $$ゲッター線$$! Before that power swallows you, I'll send you to my underworld!」

653:t_101:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$ゲッター$$ Robo is my arms and legs! No matter how dangerous a power this thing has, it's my partner!」

653:t_101:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Prepare yourself, $$勇者ガラダブラ#pilot$$! I'll make you taste the terror of $$ゲッター$$ too!」

653:t_102:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let's settle this, $$ガラダブラ$$!」

653:t_102:1.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「That name of yours, hero! Today, I'm taking it!」

653:t_102:2.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「If you want it, take it with your own hands! But don't think it will be easy to get!」

653:t_102:3.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「I am $$勇者ガラダブラ#pilot$$! The strongest warrior, renowned as without equal in $$オリュンポス$$!」

653:t_102:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then I'll teach you! Whether it's the strongest or the absolute, I'll punch through all of it! That's my drill!!」

653:t_103:0.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「$$ゼウス$$, God of Light! You fool who defies Lord $$ハーデス$$!」

653:t_103:1.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Enough of your prattle, $$ガラダブラ$$! If you are a warrior hailed as a hero, then hurl everything you have at me!」

653:t_103:2.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Heh heh heh... So my intent is an open book to you.」

653:t_103:3.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Exactly! Having come this far, the will of Lord $$ハーデス$$ means nothing! Battle against a strong foe who sets my blood boiling is all that matters!」

653:t_103:4.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「$$ゼウス$$, called one of the Three Pillar Gods of $$オリュンポス$$! That mighty arm, I shall force down with my own strength!」

653:t_103:5.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Come, $$ガラダブラ$$! I am no longer a god of $$オリュンポス$$!」

653:t_103:6.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「As a single warrior living in this universe, I shall crush your arrogance and hubris!」
